API 格式的工具，而不是画布工作流程 — 请先阅读此内容

此 JSON 不会拖到 ComfyUI 画布上。这是故意的，而不是疏忽。它是由脚本驱动的可再现性工具，因此每次运行都可以根据上一次运行进行字节检查。如果你想要一个图表可以点击进入，这不是那样的。

索赔要求明确

重新运行此线束，保持不变在同一台机器上再现参考图像，平均绝对差为0.0000— 位相同。不是“接近”。完全相同的。

商业安全，根据主要来源进行验证

该工具加载三个文件，这三个文件都是 Apache 2.0：

  • Flux-2-klein-base-4b.safetensors — 黑森林实验室

  • Flux2-vae.safetensors — 黑森林实验室

  • qwen_3_4b.safetensors (Qwen3-4B) — 阿里巴巴 / Qwen

4B/9B 的划分很重要。FLUX.2 klein 4B Base 是 Apache 2.0。 9B Base 不是——它是非商业性的。交换到 9B 后，该堆栈的商业安全性不再成立。验证自己而不是相信我的话：HuggingFace 模型卡和许可证.md在 BFL Flux2 存储库中。

Apache 2.0 是宽松的，不是公共领域——重新分发需要许可证文本和归属。相应地归功于 BFL 和 Qwen。

再现性陷阱——报告不匹配之前请阅读

  1. 使用全精度文件，而不是 fp8。fp8 产生不同的像素。相同的种子，相同的提示，不同的数字。

  2. 请注意嵌套路径。UNET 从 split_files/diffusion_models/ 子文件夹加载。如果您的安装是平面安装，请嵌套该文件或编辑unet_name。

  3. 请勿更改步骤、cfg、采样器或分辨率。30 / 5.0 / 欧拉 / 1024x1280。每一件都是锁的一部分。

方法一言以蔽之

保持种子和所有其他标记相同，并且仅交换姿势短语。锁是整个提示，而不仅仅是种子。

已知限制 - 在此命名，以便您不必查找它们

这附带了已记录的缺陷。一个隐藏其故障的干净演示不如一个能解释故障的有缺陷的演示有价值。

  1. 姿势短语泄漏到脸上。高能量的姿势重写了角色的脸部，提示中的面部术语没有改变。姿势越有活力，脸部需要的即时重量就越多。失败案例作为标签图包含在内，而不是悄悄删除。

  2. 命名一个区域而不对其进行限制会导致偏差。提示说“裸露的奶油色毛皮胸部和腹部”，但从未说明该区域的结束位置，并且奶油色区域在不同姿势的不同高度处终止。有界限、有解释、故意未修复——修复它会强制完全重新锁定。

  3. 决定论意味着你不能重新滚动。相同的种子加上相同的提示永远等于相同的像素。没有“再试一次”。该方法的真正权衡，而不是错误。

许可——三个独立的层

  • 模型堆栈— Apache 2.0，允许商业用途（见上文）

  • 工具、脚本和文档——麻省理工学院。明确授予商业用途。以此构建付费角色套件；这就是重点。

  • 演示图像— CC BY-NC 4.0，归属 ytcreator432327。

图像为何不同：小熊猫是品牌资产。该方法是完全商业化的。角色不是。用这款背带打造一个商业角色套件——你就是无法运送我的小熊猫。

关于人工智能图像和版权：在大多数司法管辖区，现状尚未确定。这授予了存在的任何权利，而不是主张我可能不持有的排他所有权。

完整的文章和来源

方法演练、v1-v3 案例研究以及线束本身：https://github.com/zoomg333/pickaxe-consistency-kit

同一个人，两个手柄：Civitaiytcreator432327和 GitHub变焦333。如此声明，存储库和此列表在两个方向上相互验证 - 要求您信任其测量的版本不应该有无法验证的作者。

如果有用，请关注或发表评论。在构建一套之前，我正在评估是否需要一套更完整的商业安全角色套件。有关商业用途、变体或付费版本的问题正是我正在寻找的信号 - 在这里询问他们。

o.en:
An API-format harness, not a canvas workflow — read this first

This JSON will not drag onto the ComfyUI canvas. That is deliberate, not an oversight. It is a reproducibility harness driven by a script, so every run is byte-checkable against the last one. If you want a graph to click around in, this is not that.

The claim, stated precisely

Re-running this harness unchangedon the same machinereproduces the reference image with a mean absolute difference of0.0000— bit-identical. Not "close". Identical.

Commercial-safe, verified against primary sources

The harness loads three files and all three are Apache 2.0:

  • flux-2-klein-base-4b.safetensors — Black Forest Labs

  • flux2-vae.safetensors — Black Forest Labs

  • qwen_3_4b.safetensors (Qwen3-4B) — Alibaba / Qwen

The 4B/9B split matters.FLUX.2 klein 4B Base is Apache 2.0. 9B Base is NOT — it ships non-commercial. Swap in 9B and the commercial-safety of this stack no longer holds. Verify yourself rather than taking my word: the HuggingFace model cards andLICENSE.mdin the BFL flux2 repo.

Apache 2.0 is permissive, not public domain — redistribution requires the licence text and attribution. Credit BFL and Qwen accordingly.

Reproducibility traps — read before reporting a mismatch

  1. Use the full-precision file, not fp8.fp8 produces different pixels. Same seed, same prompt, different numbers.

  2. Note the nested path.The UNET loads from a split_files/diffusion_models/ subfolder. If your install is flat, nest the file or edit unet_name.

  3. Do not change steps, cfg, sampler, or resolution.30 / 5.0 / euler / 1024x1280. Every one is part of the lock.

The method, in one sentence

Hold the seed and every other token identical, and swap only the pose phrase. The lock is the whole prompt, not just the seed.

Known limits — named here so you don't have to find them

This ships with documented defects. A clean demo that hides its failures is worth less than a defective one that explains them.

  1. The pose phrase leaks into the face.A high-energy pose rewrote the character's face with no facial term changed in the prompt. The more energetic the pose, the more prompt weight the face needs. The failure case is included as a labelled figure rather than quietly deleted.

  2. Naming a region without bounding it invites drift.The prompt says "bare cream fur chest and belly" but never says where that region ends, and the cream area terminates at different heights across poses. Bounded, explained, and deliberately unfixed — fixing it forces a full re-lock.

  3. Determinism means you cannot re-roll.Same seed plus same prompt equals the same pixels, forever. There is no "try again". A genuine trade-off of the method, not a bug.

Licensing — three separate layers

  • Model stack— Apache 2.0, commercial use permitted (see above)

  • The harness, script, and documentation— MIT. Commercial use explicitly granted. Build a paid character kit with this; that is the point.

  • The demo images— CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution ytcreator432327.

Why the images differ: the red panda is a brand asset. The method is given away completely and commercially. The character is not. Build a commercial character kit with this harness — you just can't ship my red panda.

On AI images and copyright: the status is unsettled in most jurisdictions. This grants whatever rights exist rather than asserting exclusive ownership I may not hold.

Full write-up and source

Method walkthrough, the v1-v3 case study, and the harness itself:https://github.com/zoomg333/pickaxe-consistency-kit

Same person, two handles: Civitaiytcreator432327and GitHubzoomg333. Stated so the repo and this listing verify against each other in both directions — a release that asks you to trust its measurements should not have an unverifiable author.

If this is useful, follow or leave a comment.I'm gauging whether there's demand for a fuller commercial-safe character kit before building one. Questions about commercial use, variations, or a paid version are exactly the signal I'm looking for — ask them here.
